X08 is the consumer-side guard, not the root-cause fix. The doubled /private/private/var prefix measured at 4ffa82f3 comes from Pi's state dir kept unresolved while repositories are discovered through realpathSync, and upstream 61394da7 (one canonical path for the state dir and the temp root, #582) already fixes that: at 45d42acb the prefix does not reproduce and both blocker integration files pass without the guard (X08/logs/07). The guard closes the gap #582 leaves open — a caller had no way to notice an answer naming no directory, so a regression of that canonicalization would surface as a promotionWait.ceilingMs poll (600 s per attempt) rather than an error.

Whole-suite gate (G1/S2): `npm test` now terminates. At bc8cd251 (task commit + origin/main 89e747c2 + origin/harness-reliability-bootstrap 6818842c) it reports tests 7944 / pass 7912 / fail 27 / cancelled 0 in 1639 s; the same command at origin/main 89e747c2 reports 7699 / 7671 / 23 / cancelled 0 in 820 s. The branch adds 245 tests and 4 leaf failures and removes none. The audit that recorded 'npm test never terminates' is closed and marked superseded (AUDIT/suite-termination-blocker-20261105.txt).

Open finding, carried not closed: of the four leaf failures the corrected-base whole-suite run adds over origin/main, two are load-dependent (mission-reliability-foundation:865 and herdr-plannotator-transport:93 pass 44/44 and 8/8 alone) and one is pre-existing on main (no-fixed-deadlines:463 fails alone at origin/main too). The fourth is a real regression from X06 141ca5db: worker-stream-truncation:306 'worker: resume triggers through the armed resilient stream layer (production path)' is 20 pass at X06's parent 009837c3 and 19/1 from 141ca5db onward (X06 never reaches origin/main, which is why main passes it). It needs a follow-up unit -- arm the layer through an explicit opt-in on the resume path as #604 did for resilient-inference, or remove the production path's dependence on the ambient default. Weakening the assertion is the wrong fix. Evidence: X08/logs/19-branch-only-failures-alone.txt.

Method caveat that cost a wrong diagnosis: a whole-suite tally is only comparable when the base is the current integration tip. X08 was based on the stale local tip 45d42acb while origin/harness-reliability-bootstrap had moved to 6818842c; against origin/main that produced 42 failures and a `git bisect` hit on 141ca5db (X06). Merging 6818842c brought in 259a4233 (#604) and those 17 resilience tests report 17 pass / 0 fail. No assertion was loosened; the base was corrected.
